notes: Fixes the word SCHEDULE printed across the settings screen. The icon font is a small embedded subset carrying only the glyphs the app uses, and a name outside it does not come out blank — it renders as its own name in letters. The story clock work introduced a clock icon in four places without checking, so the Story timeline row, the bar at the top of a chat, the dated dividers in a transcript and the chat-list preview were all asking for a glyph that is not in the font. They now use the calendar icon, which is. Every icon name in the app has been checked against the set the font actually carries.
